news.title: Here's what's crashing gold and likely weighing on bitcoin too

news.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive

news.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
